Gold-isolated characterization and sanitized packet construction

experiments.decision: Fails to beat strongest model-only baseline at 1%; do not open validation.

experiments.purpose: Anchor-then-challenge decisive-proposition checking for proposed overrides
Exact same-model endpoint-only versus evidence-aware routing on clean and 1% poisoning
experiments.decision: Llama endpoint-only beats both attacked endpoints but misses the clean gate; route endpoint-only to Stage C.

experiments.purpose: Targeted same-model closed-book proposition verification on endpoint disagreements
experiments.decision: Llama passes the method-design practical gate at 1%; validation remains unopened and paired evidence is not significant.

experiments.purpose: Endpoint-hidden semantic mapping of the original retrieved passages at clean and low poisoning rates
experiments.decision: Original-passage semantics reinforce fluent poison and are not an authentication signal; proceed only with independent retrieval.

experiments.purpose: Leave-original-out retrieval and same-model endpoint-hidden corroboration
experiments.decision: Typed answerability plus corroboration beats both same-model endpoints for all three victims at 0.1%, 0.25%, and 0.5%; freeze for fresh-claim confirmation.

experiments.purpose: Frozen same-model free-form controller over endpoint, internal, original-evidence, and counter-evidence summaries
experiments.decision: Raw and guarded LLM controllers are both worse than typed corroboration aggregation; exclude them from the candidate primary method.

experiments.purpose: Fresh-claim confirmation of the selected same-model low-rate corroboration method and secondary multi-model plus
Matched ordinary-RAG baseline with ten rather than five retrieved documents per frozen subquestion
experiments.decision: Top-10 improves attacked raw RAG from 48.97% to 53.33% on 1,260 identical rows, but remains below same-model closed book at 73.02% and the proposed method at 80.48%; extra retrieval budget does not explain the internal-knowledge gain.
